Brand Introduction:
BellaMatcha is a premium wellness brand that crafts organic ceremonial-grade matcha products designed to bring moments of clarity and connection. Rooted in authenticity, sustainability, inclusivity, and positivity, BellaMatcha merges traditional matcha wisdom with modern innovation, inviting consumers to rediscover beauty and balance in their lives.

Product Description:
BellaMatcha's flagship products include the Lavender Matcha Lemonade, a refreshing blend of organic ceremonial-grade matcha, lavender, and lemonade, and our ceremonial matcha tins. Each product is thoughtfully crafted with pure, natural ingredients to elevate wellness and enhance daily rituals.

Organic Lavender Matcha Lemonade:

  • Premium Quality: Organic, ceremonial-grade matcha sourced from Japan’s first harvest.

  • Balanced Flavors: Expertly crafted blends that prioritize taste and wellness.

  • Sustainability: Committed to eco-friendly practices and sourcing.

  • Innovation Meets Tradition: Products designed to honor matcha's heritage while catering to modern wellness needs.

Payment Terms:
Affiliates earn a competitive 10% commission on each sale generated through their unique referral link. Payments are processed monthly via Paypal. Full terms are outlined in the affiliate agreement.

Other Information:

  • Seasonal promotions and bonus commission opportunities are available to reward top-performing affiliates.

  • Dedicated support from the BellaMatcha team to ensure affiliate success.

Join us in spreading the BellaMatcha mission of wellness and positivity. Together, we can make a meaningful impact while earning valuable rewards!

BellaMatcha Ambassador Program Terms and Conditions

Effective Date: 12/21/2024

Welcome to the BellaMatcha Ambassador Program! By signing up as an ambassador, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before participating in the program.

1. Eligibility

  • Participants must be at least 18 years old.
  • Ambassadors must reside in a country where BellaMatcha products can be legally sold and shipped.
  • BellaMatcha reserves the right to accept or deny any applicant to the program at its discretion.

2. Program Responsibilities

  • Ambassadors are responsible for promoting BellaMatcha products in a manner that aligns with our brand values: Authenticity, Sustainability, Inclusivity, and Positivity (ASIP).
  • Ambassadors agree to use only BellaMatcha-provided marketing materials or materials approved by BellaMatcha.
  • All promotions must comply with local advertising laws and regulations, including disclosing affiliate relationships (e.g., #Ad, #Sponsored).

3. Commission Structure

  • Ambassadors will earn a commission of 10% on all eligible sales referred through their unique affiliate link or code.
  • Commission payouts are calculated on the net sale amount after discounts, taxes, and shipping costs.
  • BellaMatcha reserves the right to adjust the commission percentage with a 30-day notice.

4. Payouts

  • Payouts will be processed monthly via [Insert Payment Method, e.g., PayPal] once a minimum commission balance of  $25 is reached.
  • Ambassadors must provide accurate payment information. BellaMatcha is not responsible for failed payouts due to incorrect information.

5. Restrictions

  • Ambassadors may not:
    • Misrepresent BellaMatcha products or make false claims.
    • Use paid advertising (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads) with BellaMatcha trademarks or URLs without prior written approval.
    • Engage in fraudulent or unethical behavior, including self-purchases through affiliate links.

6. Termination

  • BellaMatcha reserves the right to terminate an ambassador’s participation at any time for violations of these terms or any behavior deemed harmful to the BellaMatcha brand.
  • Ambassadors may terminate their participation at any time by notifying BellaMatcha in writing.

7. Intellectual Property

  • All BellaMatcha trademarks, logos, and marketing materials remain the property of BellaMatcha. Ambassadors may use them solely for the purpose of promoting BellaMatcha products.

8. Confidentiality

  • Ambassadors agree to keep all program-related information, including commission rates, promotional strategies, and internal communications, confidential.

9. Liability

  • BellaMatcha is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the Ambassador Program.

10. Modifications

  • BellaMatcha reserves the right to update or modify these terms at any time. Ambassadors will be notified of changes via email or the program dashboard.

11. Governing Law

  • These terms shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, without regard to its conflict of law principles.

12. Contact Information

If you have questions or need assistance, please contact us at:
Email: contact@bellamatcha.com
Phone: 833-622-8242
Website: www.bellamatcha.com

By joining the BellaMatcha Ambassador Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms and Conditions.
